pr_body: Fixes #6380 Adds a new `codespace rebuild` command that rebuilds a codespace. If the codespace is already rebuilding, then this command no-ops and exits successfully. The new command starts a Live Share session and orders a rebuild using RPC. If #6358 lands before this PR merges, then this PR should adopt the new gRPC protocol.
pr_comments:
> The only thing I can think of to fix that though is a something like a factory wrapper around the session builder, but that adds complexity

We could add a new `SessionInitializer` function type that `startLiveShareSession` implements and add an `initializer SessionInitializer` parameter to `Rebuild`. Then, we can use `startLiveShareSession` for the real deal and `startMockLiveShareSession` for testing.
@cmbrose Can you merge this for me? I don't have write access.

issue_context.title: New `cs rebuild` command to rebuild a codespace
issue_context.body: ### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve I'd like a new command to rebuild my codespaces from the GitHub CLI. ### Proposed solution This will benefit all codespaces users who aren't using VS Code. For example, users who use `gh cs jupyter` to use their codespace. ### Additional context

review_comments: Can we verify this was actually called?
Would be great to support -c at least
`cobra.NoArgs` means no positional args (`gh cs rebuild positionalArg` versus `gh cs rebuild --flag flagValue`). This supports `-c`, see a few lines down before `return rebuildCmd`
Is there a log file or any more descriptive message we could provide or point to?

I don't think so. The RPC call _only_ returns `true`/`false`. Unfortunately, there doesn't seem to be a more detailed message available here.

Note that the lines above this one check for an error after making the RPC call. If something goes wrong there, we get a helpful error message.

We could modify the RPC service to return a more helpful error message. That's how the Jupyter and SSH RPC calls work: https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/a493f6dbe888b43625aaa8b2c7e01ca6445da1b2/pkg/liveshare/session.go#L105
